text: Open with Airport Systems / HKG transfer desk, not “AI for aviation”.
Name two beneficiaries: the passenger and the typhoon queue.
Narrate demo steps 3–6 as ops theater (typhoon, CX254, reasoning, approve).
Do not add hardware or a robot. FlyLab won without one.
Use coach language: Q77 + Altéa cryptic is the bottleneck.
Claim ESG only if we can count fewer stranded nights. Otherwise omit.
Agent-in-the-loop is why Fight4Flight lost and we should not.
Pair the pitch with a real CX role (transfer agent + IT), FlyLab-style.
Say: LLM drafts; engine decides; guard strips hallucinated flights.
Sit beside Passenger Recovery as the last-90-minute special-handling layer.
Pilot metrics already in PILOT_PROPOSAL: 5s queue, reasoning not from LLM, flight-number-safe push.
Call the engine a control cycle on station time. MCT table is the DSL.
Seeded sim = HOOTL. Live adapter = HITL. RECONNECT_PILOT=off is abort.
Describe the iPad as one glass (queue, connection, action). Open MCT analogue.
Walk + WCH + UM is the wedge. ConnectionSaver made walk-time a product.
Hold-the-outbound is a different decision. Park it in LATER. Know it exists.
Do not import MILP aircraft-crew recovery. That is AOCC, not T1.
Do not scrape public FIDS. Pilot uses operational MQTT. OpenSky is research-only.
Use ChatGPT trip planners and GPT compensation as foils, not as features.
Do not invent impact numbers. NAAR and ConnectionSaver led with real ones; we do not have them yet.
2019 was cancelled. Do not treat the empty year as proof that ops products only started winning in 2023.
GME is a cloneable 2021 repo, not a press champion. Do not fill unpublished trophy cells from GitHub.
HX is Navitaire New Skies. CX transfer is Altéa. One PSS sentence does not cover both BUs.
2017 top six: one crew tablet won; one IROPS app placed; four lifestyle tools did not. The mix has not changed.
GingTrip lost in 2023 and came back with a trolley. We already have the typhoon button. Do not wait a year.
2025 split student vs employee tracks (36 + 12 teams). FlyLab is the employee-track analogue. Pair with a CX role.
Do not copy last year’s winning technique. FlyVision rebuilt cargo CV after NAAR already won it.
Cathay Green ran out of time on the first pitch and still won the finals. Narrate steps 3–6; do not add a robot.
2023 2nd RU FlyMate is a GenAI PRM app with GitHub. WCH is already +15 min in mct.ts. Do not demo a passenger chatbot.
